description: This file defines domain models for API responses in an Android TV application. It includes a data class ContentItem representing a content entity with an ID, name, and optional poster URL, and an enum HomeCategory listing different categories with their API paths and display titles.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Represents a content item with an ID, name, and optional poster URL used in UI.

classes.name: HomeCategory
classes.description: An enum of supported categories, each with API path and display title.
